title: RIME: Representation-Induced Mechanics and Evolution, v2.0 repository snapshot
description: RIME studies spectral, transport, accessibility, deformation, reporting, alignment, and bounded interpretation structures in finite-dimensional represented systems. This v2.0 repository snapshot contains the public Papers I-XIV contracts, manuscripts, accepted evidence, figures, and source-addressed validation material as of commit 28711f67aee03b02786c8e9f451156576c0f65ef. Later v2.1 manuscript revisions, experiments, figures, tests, and contract candidates are excluded from this snapshot.
notes: Repository snapshot base commit: 28711f67aee03b02786c8e9f451156576c0f65ef. The metadata files are release metadata added on top of that immutable source snapshot; they do not change the scientific v2.0 source boundary. Runtime implementations belong to the separate sof-runtime repository.
